# Facility Floor Plan attribution

The ZNTEQR Facility Floor Plan feature is an original adaptation inspired by the interaction model of
Doug Trier's **Trier OS** floor-plan module.

Upstream project: https://github.com/DougTrier/trier-os

Trier OS is published under the MIT License at the repository level. The implementation in this
repository was rewritten to match ZNTEQR's React/TypeScript/Supabase architecture rather than copied
as a drop-in module, because Trier OS uses an Express/SQLite backend and additional UWB/LiDAR/CAD
services that do not exist in ZNTEQR.

The upstream repository's copyright and MIT license remain with Doug Trier.
